reading.body:
H5 Data Centers San Antonio operates 85,000 square feet of colocation space across two facilities at a single address in downtown San Antonio. The operator publishes no megawatt capacity figure for this campus. Without a power specification, the scale of this site relative to the state's mapped data center infrastructure cannot be assessed from published sources.

The facility qualifies to host SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliant workloads. Redundancy is specified as 2N UPS backup, N+1 cooling and generator support with 48 hours of diesel runtime. The campus connects to 35 carrier networks including dark fiber and 100 Gbps options, indicating connectivity sufficient for multi-tenant enterprise use but not optimized for the sustained single-tenant power draws typical of AI training clusters.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities and 468 MW of published capacity spread across 18 of them. H5 San Antonio ranks 19th among Texas facilities by published megawatt capacity, which means it either publishes no figure or publishes below the threshold of the 18th-ranked site. The absence of any MW disclosure from the operator's spec page places this campus outside the set of facilities with quantifiable power constraints or scaling potential as measured by this site's methodology.
